steps_per_epoch: ceil(target_training_rows / target_batch), fresh permutation without replacement for target
source_policy: Reuse v8 scaffold and canonical exclusion; source train.csv only. No external labels. No test-label access.
selection: One fixed candidate family, three blend weights selected only by historical train OOF; official valid and repeat gates unchanged. No retries after rejection.
notes: This separately versioned training correction caps target exposures at 35 true passes instead of v8 fixed 115200 draws per seed.
Keep all v8 decisions frozen. v9 baseline reconstructs cumulative v8 OOF and repeat predictions; v8 platform score is unknown.
No relaxation of task-level, fold-level, auxiliary-metric, or low-similarity gates.
Three deterministic seeds and label smoothing reduce variance and confident fitting of sparse classification noise.
Same data has historical reuse and is not untouched evidence. Cannot infer platform score or guarantee blind non-regression.
No automatic upload. Final submission must retain the successful original CSV format.
